text: ほそくて　じょうぶな　いとを　はりめぐらして　わなを　しかけると　えものが　かかるのを　ひたすらまつ。

structure.jp: ほそくて　じょうぶな　いとを　はりめぐらして
structure.en: it strings thin, strong thread all around and

structure.jp: わなを　しかけると
structure.en: once it has set the trap

structure.jp: えものが　かかるのを

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: の after a verb turns the whole action into a thing, so it can be what someone waits for. えものが　かかるのを　まつ = 'wait for prey to get caught'.

patterns.name: 〜と (when)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb means 'once this is done, that follows'. わなを　しかけると = 'once it sets the trap'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins one word to the next like 'and'; the same thing happens later with はりめぐらして. ほそくて　じょうぶな = 'thin and strong'.
